subject: Expansion request: enabling three new teams / service boundary plan
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@kestrellabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Nina Lopez <nina.lopez@kestrellabs.com>
Cc: procure@kestrellabs.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New projects + renewal questions

Hey Jonas,

Quick note from Kestrel — we are planning to spin up three new project teams next quarter (Clinical Insights, SearchOps, and Billing Analytics) that will each call the Redwood API. We want to understand: 1) how many API keys we should provision (per team vs per app), 2) recommended capacity bump for predictable latency, and 3) whether we can adjust terms ahead of our renewal on Oct 1 to reflect higher committed usage.

High level constraints:
- Pilot period: 4 weeks per team, staggered start (one every two weeks)
- Target throughput: ~120 QPS across the three projects at peak
- Data controls: Clinical Insights needs VPC-private logs for HIPAA adjacency; others are standard hosted

Can you send a short plan and cost/term options? We’d prefer something that avoids a big admin effort on our side — ideally a single addendum to our existing agreement and scoped SOW. I attached a quick spreadsheet with projected call volumes.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Head of Platform Engineering
Kestrel Labs

Attachments: Kestrel_Expansion_Requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@kestrellabs.com>, Nina Lopez <nina.lopez@kestrellabs.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New projects + renewal questions

Samir — really useful summary, thanks. High-level proposal below — happy to iterate in a quick call.

Option A (recommended, predictable):
- 3 team-based API keys (one per project) to simplify rollout, with key-level quotas and per-key prefix caching enabled.
- Capacity: reserve a Dedicated burst pool sized for 140 QPS peak to leave headroom (estimating 20% spike).
- Term: addendum that extends committed units for 12 months with quarterly true-ups.
- Price: incremental committed discount tier (we can offer an 8% blended credit for the first 12 months if you commit to the higher baseline).

Option B (low-friction pilot):
- 1 shared API key for the pilot phase with scoped per-project namespaces + telemetry segmentation.
- On-demand capacity with auto-burst; convert to dedicated pool once pilot shows stable SLOs.

Operational notes:
- Clinical Insights (HIPAA adjacency): we recommend Private deployment for that team's project or enable strict log redaction and KMS integration on hosted. We'll need a short security questionnaire update.
- Provisioning timeline: 5 business days for keys + telemetry segmentation; Dedicated pool provisioning ~10 business days after commitment.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm whether you want per-team keys (A) or a shared pilot (B).
2) Ben and Laura, can you validate pricing and support runway?
3) If yes, I’ll draft an addendum + SOW and send the DocuSign link.

Linking the spreadsheet you sent into the HubSpot deal.

— Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

Attachments: None (referenced: Kestrel_Expansion_Requirements.xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New projects + renewal questions (internal)

Jonas — quick internal reply so we have alignment before I talk dollars with Samir.

- Pricing: We can support Option A with a 10% blended credit on incremental committed units for the first 12 months if they increase baseline by at least 50%. That gets us reasonable margin and simplifies procurement.
- SLA/terms: If we’re doing Private for Clinical Insights, include standard Private pricing + KMS integration fee; I’ve added a note in the SOW about audit log retention.
- Onboarding: Marissa, estimate time to provision three keys + telemetry/linking to their APM (should be ~3 business days once keys are requested). Also confirm Dedicated pool lead time — currently ~10 business days (cloud region permitting).

Suggested doc attachments to send to customer: Kestrel_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (outline + timeline), short addendum template.

I’ll draft the addendum language (commit increments + credit) and share for review. Once we have Samir’s confirm, I’ll send DocuSign.

— Ben Carter
Sales Director | Redwood Inference

From: Nina Lopez <nina.lopez@kestrellabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: procure@kestrellabs.com, samir.rao@kestrellabs.com
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New projects + renewal questions

Jonas / Ben — thanks for the clear options. We reviewed internally and want to proceed with Option A (team-based keys + Dedicated pool). A few quick asks before we finalize:

- Can you scope the addendum so the Dedicated pool commitment starts immediately and counts toward our Oct 1 renewal?
- We prefer a single addendum that covers all three projects and includes the 10% blended credit you referenced.
- Please include a line item for the Private deployment work for Clinical Insights (we expect a short KMS integration and a security run-through).

If you can drop the SOW + addendum for signature I’ll route to procurement and we’ll aim to kick off the first team pilot the week of Sep 27.

We’re good to take a DocuSign link. Proposed kickoff: Sep 27 — please confirm availability for a 60-minute onboarding call.

Thanks,
Nina Lopez
VP, Platform Operations | Kestrel Labs
procure@kestrellabs.com
